sample_texts: Spend less time on apps that distract you.
Solve a quick math challenge to keep using the app.
Gets harder the longer you stay
Challenges increase in difficulty the longer you keep scrolling.
PlugBrain needs the following permissions to work correctly.
Lets PlugBrain track app usage so it can block distracting apps at the right time.
Allows PlugBrain to display a challenge while you use a distracting app.
Allows PlugBrain to detect when apps are open.
Ensures that PlugBrain keeps running reliably even when your device tries to save battery.
Allow the required permissions to proceed.

PlugBrain uses the Accessibility service to see which app is open. When you open an app you chose to block, or a calculator during a challenge, PlugBrain shows a math challenge first.

PlugBrain only reads the app's name. It doesn't read what's on your screen or what you type, and nothing leaves your phone.
Find PlugBrain, then turn on the switch and confirm.
Detects when you open an app you chose to block so PlugBrain can show a math challenge. Only the app's name is read.
Allow PlugBrain 🧠 to have full control of your device?
Full control is appropriate for apps that help you with accessibility needs, but not for most apps.
It can read all content on the screen and display content over other apps.
It can track your interactions with an app or a hardware sensor, and interact with apps on your behalf.
